package.name: robot_dog_ball_grab
package.description: Ball grab/release programs for the RAICOM delivery task: vendor hardware interface + project-trained ONNX ball model. Includes ball_yolo_grab.py (grab), ball_release.py (release), rotate.py (180° turn), ball_grab_release.py (grab→turn→release orchestration). Runs on the robot host, kept in catkin_ws as this task's code home.
